name: ab logo
code:
make "o 58.968
make "i 36.432
make "u arccos 33.504 / :o
make "v arccos 33.504 / :i
to curve :r :d
  localmake "c 2 * :r * sin :d
  lt :d repeat 72 [fd :c lt :d + :d] rt :d
end
fitwindow 290
cs st setbg 0 setpc 7
repeat 2 [
  pu setx 0 lt 90 fd 24.6 lt 90 pd
  filled 7 [
    fd :o lt 90 fd :o - :i lt 90 fd :o
    curve :o (360 - :u) / 144
    lt :u fd :o * (sin :u) - :i * sin :v lt 180 - :v
    curve -:i (:v - 360) / 144
  ]
]
make "p list 120 -:o
pu seth towards :p setpos :p

name: flower
code:
; Twelve squares rotated into a flower
to square :s
  repeat 4 [fd :s rt 90]
end
to flower
  repeat 12 [square 25 rt 30]
end
fitwindow 90 ; fit a 90-step window to the canvas
cs setpc 4 flower

name: koch
code:
; Koch snowflake
to koch :len :depth
  if :depth = 0 [fd :len stop]
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1 lt 60
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1 rt 120
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1 lt 60
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1
end
to snowflake :len :depth
  repeat 3 [koch :len :depth rt 120]
end
fitwindow 90 ; fit a 90-step window to the canvas
cs pu setxy -17.5 -30 pd setpc 3 snowflake 60 3

name: spiral
code:
; Tail-recursive spiral that stops once its side passes 35 steps
to spiral :s
  if :s > 35 [stop]
  fd :s rt 91
  spiral :s + 1
end
fitwindow 70 ; fit a 70-step window to the canvas
cs setpc 6 spiral 1

name: stars
code:
; Lists, templates and colour
to star :n
  repeat 5 [fd :n rt 144]
end
fitwindow 120 ; fit a 120-step window to the canvas
cs
foreach [1 2 4 5 6 9 12 14] [
  setpc ?
  pu setxy (-50 + 12 * repcount) (10 * sin 40 * repcount) pd
  star 10
]

name: stencil demo
code:
; A stencil to print: block letters "OK" over a star.
; Pen size is the slot width in mm (1 step = 1 mm). Run:
;   termlogo examples/stencil_demo.logo -o demo.stl
; Islands (the middle of the O and the star) are bridged automatically.

to letter.o
  pu setxy 0 0 pd setheading 0
  repeat 2 [fd 40 rt 90 fd 28 rt 90]
end
to letter.k
  pu setxy 40 0 pd setheading 0 fd 40
  pu setxy 40 20 pd setheading 45 fd 28
  pu setxy 40 20 pd setheading 135 fd 28
end
to star :s repeat 5 [fd :s rt 144] end
fitwindow 160 ; fit the view (the stencil keeps 1 step = 1 mm)
cs setpensize 3 setpc 7
letter.o letter.k
setpensize 1.6
pu setxy 6 -48 pd seth 72 star 46

name: stencil fill
code:
; A stencil with cut-out areas: a filled window, and two FILLED shapes. Run:
;   termlogo examples/stencil_fill.logo -o fill.stl
; FILL cuts out the area enclosed by the lines already drawn. The small square
; inside the window is left as an island and is bridged automatically.
; FILLED cuts out the shape the turtle traces, with the pen up or down.

fitwindow 160 ; fit the view (the stencil keeps 1 step = 1 mm)
cs setpensize 2
repeat 4 [fd 30 rt 90]
pu setxy 10 10 pd repeat 4 [fd 10 rt 90]
pu setxy 5 5 pd setpc 2 fill
setpc 4 pu setxy 45 0 pd filled 6 [repeat 3 [fd 30 rt 120]]
pu setxy -40 0 filled 1 [repeat 36 [fd 3 rt 10]]
ht

name: tree
code:
; Recursive binary tree
to tree :size
  if :size < 3 [stop]
  fd :size
  lt 25 tree :size * 0.7
  rt 50 tree :size * 0.7
  lt 25
  bk :size
end
fitwindow 100 ; fit a 100-step window to the canvas
cs pu bk 41 pd setpc 2 tree 28
